short_description: Consumer-facing appearance trait that reports a cautious panel-relative signal for a broader residual hair-color tendency within the current local reference panel.
summary_note: Usable consumer-facing appearance trait with practical raw-array support, but the source phenotype is a broad residual hair-color bucket rather than a clean named shade, so interpretation should stay especially cautious in the no-imputation workflow.
what_it_measures: A panel-relative polygenic signal associated with the source model's residual 'other hair color' category, meaning a relative tendency away from the more directly named hair-color groupings represented by the companion scores in this project, calibrated within the current local empirical reference panel.
interpretation_template: Other hair-color tendency is presented here as a cautious residual appearance signal, not a direct readout of current observed hair color or a precise named shade. {interpretation}
caution_text: Use as a cautious panel-relative signal only. No imputation or ancestry-adjusted normalization is used. This score comes from a broad residual hair-color category, and the output should not be treated as a deterministic real-world result or as a direct label for current observed hair color.
limitations: Percentiles and z-scores are relative to the local reference panel, not to a population-wide benchmark.

The source phenotype is a broad residual hair-color bucket rather than a single clean named shade, so this result should be interpreted as a loose comparative signal rather than as a precise visible-hair-color label.
Observed hair color can also shift with age, graying, dyeing, bleaching, grooming, and other non-genetic factors.
confidence_note: Confidence reflects overlap and reference robustness under the no-imputation raw-array workflow, not certainty about the real-world trait.
reference_note: Percentiles and z-scores are calibrated against a local empirical reference artifact built from raw-array files in this project; they are panel-relative, not population-wide.
